headline: Pyrin Red Hare
title: Pyrin | Red Hare Fire Mount | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a Fire mount? Meet Pyrin. Its partner skill, Red Hare, lets you ride it, and while mounted your attack type becomes Fire with five to twenty percent more Attack. At base it is a serious Kindling worker at level four, plus Lumbering at level two. That makes it a strong cooker and a decent lumberjack. Would you ride Pyrin? Comment below!
description: Pyrin in Palworld 1.0: Red Hare makes it a Fire mount with a 5 to 20 percent Attack boost, Kindling level 4 and Lumbering level 2.
